baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collars, necks, chains, and passive dragging in 40:71 form one continuous restraint-and-motion construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A collar fixes the neck, linked rings extend that fixation to an external pull, and the passive plural verb converts the restrained people from movers into moved loads.

activation_trace.role: The iron collar fixes an organ and supplies the primary bodily restraint.
The literal neck locates control at the hinge between head and torso.
Connected rings transmit constraint beyond the collar as a linked force path.
Dragging supplies forced extension along a path and removes self-directed motion.

changed_reading.before: The ayah shows prisoners wearing shackles and chains.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts a complete force-transfer apparatus: control is applied at the neck, propagated through linked chain, and resolved as involuntary transport.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain and dragging roots retain branch images of smooth flow and gliding movement even though their surface senses impose iron linkage and coercion.
baseline_models.mechanism: Continuity has not disappeared; it has been reassigned from the persons to the apparatus. The linked system moves them in an uninterrupted flow while the passive grammar denies that the motion is theirs.

activation_trace.role: Smooth running or drinking contributes an ease and continuity now possessed by the transport process, not its captives.
Connected parts provide the material series that maintains continuous traction.
A cloud's gliding withdrawal supplies a distant image of sustained movement across a medium.
Literal dragging reverses that apparent ease by locating resistance and lost agency in the human body.

changed_reading.before: Dragging is only a rough, discontinuous act of humiliation.
changed_reading.after: The motion is chillingly continuous: smoothness belongs to the chain-driven process while the people move only as resistant cargo.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly frames the condemned as people who twist themselves into disputation; immediately before the focus, that tight verbal interlacing is answered by a literal linked restraint. The chain can therefore carry a formal, not merely causal, correspondence to their mode of argument.

activation_trace.role: Intertwined contention gives the recurrent disputation a self-entangling verbal shape.
Tight twisting directly before the focus supplies a rope-making motion that the chains can materialize.
The connected iron parts turn figurative interlacing into a restraint that transmits force.
The neck collar makes the consequence bodily and prevents the model from floating free of the focus.

structural_cues: The disputation formula recurs at 40:4, 40:5, 40:35, 40:56, and immediately at 40:69; 40:70 identifies the same people before the focus scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tight twisting, intertwined contention, and a linked iron restraint; I infer a form-to-consequence arrow in which habitual argumentative twisting is exteriorized as chain. A live alternative is that disputation only identifies the punished group and contributes no formal image.

changed_reading.before: The chains are an externally imposed penalty unrelated in form to the conduct named around them.
changed_reading.after: The chains may also be the bodily after-form of tightly twisted disputation: an argument-pattern that has become an inescapable material linkage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied Book joins ordered parts, and messengers arrive by dispatch and succession. In the next ayah, connection and succession persist, but the freely transmitted sequence of words and envoys is reversed into a sequence of bodies joined and moved by force.

activation_trace.role: Joining one part to another gives the denied Book a compositional linkage that the focus can reverse materially.
Succession and dispatch make revelation arrive as an ordered message-series rather than an isolated utterance.
The chain preserves ordered connection while changing its medium from communication to iron.
Dragging changes voluntary reception of what was sent into compulsory transmission of the deniers themselves.

structural_cues: 40:2 opens with the descent of the Book; 40:22-23, 40:50-53, 40:70, and 40:78 repeat messengers or Book, with 40:70 immediately adjacent to the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joined writing, successive sending, linked chain, and dragging; I infer a mirrored reversal from transmitted message to transmitted body. The live alternative is a simple cause-and-punishment sequence without formal correspondence.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject revelation and are then punished with an unrelated chain.
changed_reading.after: A failed reception circuit reverses: what came to them through joined text and successive messengers returns as their own bodies joined and forcibly conveyed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context locates self-magnification inside breasts and seals it at the heart; the focus root for the external collar also carries hidden rancor in the chest. The neck becomes the boundary where an inward, fixed posture emerges as a visible restraint.

activation_trace.role: The breast as the source from which acts issue locates arrogance as an inward generator rather than a passing mood.
Magnifying something in the breast sharpens the explicit kibr as inward inflation.
Sealing or imprinting supplies fixation and closure at the heart.
Hidden rancor in the chest provides the focus root's internal pole and bridges moral concealment to bodily restraint.
The iron collar supplies the same root's external pole as a visible and immobilizing consequence.
The neck is the bodily threshold at which the inward fixation is rendered outward.

structural_cues: 40:35 joins disputation, sealing of the heart, and the arrogant; 40:56 explicitly locates kibr in breasts; 40:76 names the final entrants as arrogant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward kibr, a sealed heart, the focus root's hidden-rancor branch, and its collar branch; I infer an inside-to-outside materialization across the neck. A live alternative is that the collar is only juridical punishment and the shared root branches should not be narratively joined.

changed_reading.before: The collar is wholly external and begins only at the punishment scene.
changed_reading.after: The collar can expose an earlier inward captivity: self-magnification fixed in the chest has crossed the neck as an outward, undeniable restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The drag is the transfer phase of an ordered process: linked restraint conveys the subjects into hot water, onward to ignition, and finally through an entry threshold into fixed residence. The focus is therefore kinetic infrastructure between judgment and confinement, not a still portrait.

activation_trace.role: Connected chain supplies the durable coupling needed to move restrained bodies through successive stages.
Dragging is the explicit transfer operation that makes the focus scene kinetic.
Hot water provides the first receiving medium for the bodies being dragged.
Stoking and kindling supply the second operation, turning conveyance toward combustion.
The sajur restraint echoes and extends the neck-chain apparatus into the following ayah.
The gate defines an entry threshold toward which compulsory transport is directed.
Unfailing permanence locks the endpoint and prevents the transfer from being read as temporary relocation.

structural_cues: 40:71 ends in passive plural dragging; 40:72 continues the same group through fi, thumma, and fi, while 40:76 closes the sequence at gates and permanent residence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two ordered media, ignition, a gate, and permanence; I infer that the chain-and-drag construction functions as one transfer line joining them. A live alternative is that these are successive punishments without a single process mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Dragging is a generic humiliation whose destination and function are secondary.
changed_reading.after: Dragging is the operational middle of a staged confinement process: the linked bodies are conveyed through heat and ignition toward irreversible admission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier fire-scene preserves a relation between followers and the self-elevated even after authority becomes useless. The focus chain's connected parts and the neck root's group sense allow the plural captives to be read as a failed social formation hauled together, with former following surviving only as shared liability.

activation_trace.role: An attached liability latent in following makes subordination persist after its worldly benefit has vanished.
Arrogant self-elevation supplies the dominant pole of the failed follower-leader relation.
The neck root's group or connected-segment image permits the restrained plural to register as a collective unit.
Connected links give the former hierarchy a material image of inseparable shared consequence.

structural_cues: In 40:47 the weak name themselves followers of the arrogant and ask for relief; 40:48 answers that all are in the fire and no leader can detach another's share.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies followers, arrogant superiors, attached liability, a group image, and linked chains; I infer that the literal apparatus can also visualize relational consequence. A live alternative is that each captive bears an independent chain with no social linkage.

changed_reading.before: Each prisoner is dragged as an isolated individual.
changed_reading.after: The cohort may be hauled as the wreckage of a hierarchy: leadership and following remain connected only as an inescapable common liability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the rope sense of asbab belongs to Pharaoh's earlier tower episode and the focus says chain, not sabab. It remains anchored in the focus chain's connected traction and drag within the same arrogance-and-disputation arc. Downstream prose should present it only as a possible formal reversal of direction, never as a lexical identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The connected chains and dragging in 40:71 provide a literal tether and imposed direction of travel.

activation_trace.role: The sought means carry a branch image of rope or connection aimed toward ascent.
Repetition extends the aspirational linkage toward the heavens and makes direction central.
The connected chain is the concrete tether that reverses the earlier imagined connection.
Dragging replaces self-chosen upward reach with imposed movement toward punishment.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh's attempted ascent and the later chains are unrelated images.
changed_reading.after: The neck-chain may darkly reverse the sought heavenly 'means': the wished-for upward connection returns as a tether that dictates the body's destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a remote contrast because the beneficent carrying by livestock and ship appears after the focus. It remains anchored in the focus's passive forced motion and restraint apparatus. Render it as a transport-system contrast, not as a claim that carrying and dragging are synonyms or that 40:80 directly glosses 40:71.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive yushabun makes people transported loads, while collars and chains replace any supporting vehicle.

activation_trace.role: The ship supplies a vehicle that supports circular passage through water.
Being borne as an elevated load supplies the surah's beneficent form of passive transport.
The collar turns restraint itself into the point at which transport force is applied.
Dragging supplies unsupported passive motion and thus the punitive inverse of being carried.

changed_reading.before: Dragging is merely a harsher verb of locomotion.
changed_reading.after: The focus becomes a punitive anti-carriage: no creature or vessel supports the travelers, because restraint itself has become their transport infrastructure.

strongest_changes: The collar-chain-drag sequence became a force-transfer apparatus rather than a static display of bonds.
Repeated twisted disputation and rejected chains of writing and messengers gave the iron chain formal correspondences to the conduct preceding it.
The following hot-water, ignition, gate, and permanence cues turned the focus into the transfer phase of an ordered confinement process.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence made linkage do several kinds of work at once: mechanical traction, argumentative entanglement, failed message transmission, exteriorized inward arrogance, and collective liability remained distinct without displacing the literal neck restraint.
remaining_uncertainties: The argument-chain and message-chain correspondences may be formal echoes rather than intended causal images.
The inside-to-outside reading depends on carrying two distinct branches of the focus root together.
The process-line model may over-unify punishments that the sequence simply places one after another.
The rope reversal and anti-carriage readings are intentionally remote and should remain exploratory.
